title: Finalize direct procedure state after human-response resume
description:
## Problem

The direct resume command replays a persisted human response and completes procedure logic, but it bypasses the task-tracked local execution path. The procedure and its task can remain marked running after successful completion, and final task output is not updated.

## Expected behavior

Given a local procedure is waiting for a human response
And a canonical response exists
When the operator resumes the procedure
Then execution reuses the supported local task-tracked path
And the procedure and task reach their truthful terminal states
And final task output is persisted through the application-authorized artifact path.

## Acceptance

- An executable behavior test first proves resume bypasses terminal-state finalization.
- Resume uses the same local task-tracking path as initial execution.
- Successful replay completes both procedure and task and persists final output.
- No remote dispatch or storage fallback is introduced.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Kickoff: live Cognito acceptance replayed the persisted approval and wrote completed state artifacts, but Procedure remained RUNNING and the existing Task remained RUNNING because resume_procedure invokes ProcedureService directly. Writing a focused behavior test that requires resume to call the local task-tracked runner with the procedure account ID.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Milestone: the behavior-first test is green. Resume now re-enters the supported local task-tracked runner so Procedure, Task stages, and final output can reach truthful terminal state.
